scientific_question: After v177 ruled out five- and nine-camera Zero-CGLS K4/K8 as adequate field references on the already opened PoolFire p22-s01 condition, does the stable affine span of every already-open train-split PoolFire field contain a physically compatible four-frame reference, and does one unchanged CGLS K1 step preserve that capacity on the frozen geometry-only five-camera subsets?
role: post-open truth-aware field-representation capacity diagnostic on p22-s01; heldout truth determines only the offline orthogonal projection and final scoring, so no arm is a deployable initializer or predictor
physical_distinction: This diagnostic changes the field representation from a zero-start low-depth Krylov shell to a fit-field affine manifold. It does not tune K, H1, Sobolev order, geometry-quadratic weights, subset choice, lambda, thresholds, or a neural model.

fit_data.scope: all ten complete train-split PoolFire trajectories already opened before v178; no validation or test trajectory enters the affine basis
fit_data.transform: for every frame apply the frozen poolfire_xyz_to_zyx transpose, supported-interior mean gauge, and one-voxel zero boundary
fit_data.trajectory_weighting: equal because every frozen trajectory contributes exactly 101 frames

affine_span.center: arithmetic mean of all 1010 transformed fit fields
affine_span.formal_decomposition: NumPy direct thin SVD of the 1010x8192 centered field matrix using its default divide-and-conquer LAPACK path
affine_span.independent_decomposition: direct thin SVD of the 1010x8192 centered field matrix with a different LAPACK driver
affine_span.retention: retain every singular direction with sigma/sigma_max greater than or equal to 1e-10
affine_span.sign_canonicalization: largest-absolute field entry is nonnegative; ties use the lowest flat index
affine_span.target_projection: orthogonal projection of each transformed p22 field into the frozen fit affine span
affine_span.truth_role: p22 truth is used only to form this most-favorable offline capacity witness and to score it
affine_span.pre_result_numerical_audit: Before any v178 field projection or scoring, a synthetic affine-manifold counterexample showed that the proposed float64 row-Gram eigensolve could promote squared-condition-number roundoff into false retained directions. The formal decomposition was therefore replaced by a direct thin SVD, while the independent implementation remains a separately coded direct SVD with explicit LAPACK gesvd. Because neither direct SVD squares the condition number, the original result-independent relative floor 1e-10 is retained. The scientific question, data, arms, gates, and decision order are unchanged.

evaluation.sensor_control: the same four field arms on all_nine
evaluation.subset_rule: for each calibration use the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge subset index frozen before p22 truth was opened in v176; no p22-dependent subset selection
evaluation.k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual; denominator floor 1e-30; breakdown leaves the field unchanged and is reported

frozen_operator.forward: same calibrated exact-adjoint straight-ray density-gradient proxy as v176-v177

exact_call_ledger.fit_basis_and_truth_projection: offline truth-aware capacity construction with no deployment-cost claim
exact_call_ledger.truth_observation: one excluded offline forward per sensor arm, calibration, and frame

must_independently_rebuild: all ten fit input identities and 1010 transformed fields
fit mean and stable affine projector using direct SVD
all thirteen calibrated operators and all-nine controls
K0 residuals and one-step CGLS from projection and mean
all 416 metric rows, exact-call receipts, tails, gates, and final decision

decision_order: Any identity, role, transform, rank, decomposition, orthogonality, selection, operator, adjoint, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v178 inconclusive.
If affine_projection_k0 fails on both the frozen five-camera arm and all-nine control, conclude FAIL_TRAIN_FIELD_AFFINE_SPAN_CAPACITY_V178 and close this stable linear fit-field manifold.

If affine_projection_k0 passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_OBSERVATION_COMPATIBILITY_WITH_AFFINE_FIELD_HEADROOM_V178; do not attribute the gap to missing field-span capacity.
If affine_projection_k0 passes the frozen five-camera arm but affine_projection_k1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_UNCHANGED_K1_SHELL_ON_AFFINE_FIELD_WITNESS_V178.
If affine_projection_k1 passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_K1_CONDITIONING_WITH_AFFINE_FIELD_HEADROOM_V178.

If affine_projection_k0 and affine_projection_k1 pass the frozen five-camera arm and fit_mean_k0 plus fit_mean_k1 also pass it, conclude PASS_STATIC_FIT_MEAN_EXPLAINS_FIELD_REFERENCE_V178 and prefer the cheaper fixed prior; do not authorize a coefficient predictor.

Only if affine_projection_k0 and affine_projection_k1 pass the frozen five-camera arm while either fit-mean control fails may v178 conclude PASS_TRAIN_FIELD_AFFINE_SPAN_HEADROOM_V178 and authorize only a separately frozen observation-to-affine-coordinate predictability diagnostic.
No v178 outcome is a deployable algorithm, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS result, external generalization, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
